clips.text: [whispers, extremely soft ASMR, lips right against the microphone, slow and breathy] Oh... I hear you like... balls. ...With dots. [even softer, tender whisper] Just one ball. ...With dots on it.
[whispers, a little faster, slightly unsettled] But what if... there was another ball? [nervous whisper, breathing quicker] ...with MORE dots?

[obsessive whisper, slow, then speeding up] Balls. ...Balls. [faster, louder, breathless whisper] Balls. Balls. Balls. [rapid-fire, frantic, rising out of the whisper into a shout] Balls, balls, balls, balls, balls, balls, balls, BALLS!

[suddenly intense, fast, conspiratorial] Balls with dots represent atoms. [faster, louder, wide-eyed] Balls with THOUGHTS represent hopes and dreams. [almost shouting, unravelling] Balls with thoughts represent balls with DOTS. [shouting, manic] Balls with dots represent BASKETBALLS!

[screaming, completely unhinged] ANDY SERKIS! [frantic, fast, voice cracking] If you cover Andy Serkis in balls with dots, you can make ANYTHING! [yelling, rapid-fire] A CHIMP! A little shriveled guy!

[screaming, deranged, fast] He could become LASAGNA! He could become SPAGHETTI! [howling] ANDY SERKIS IS A SPAGHETTI KID! [shrieking, totally losing his mind] AND HE'S GOING TO BE EATEN BY WILL SMITH!!!
[animalistic caterwauling, yowling like a feral alley cat, wavering pitch] Mrrrrraaaaaoooowwwww! Rrrraaaaooowwwwrrr!
[feral howl at the moon, long, raw and throaty] Aaaaawooooooooooooo!
[maniacal, unhinged cackling laughter] Hahahaha! Ha ha HAHAHAHAHA! [wheezing] Heh heh heh...
[incoherent, frantic muttering, fast and breathless, making no sense] balls... dots... dots dots balls... balls with dots, dots with balls, dot ball, ball dot, dots, dots, dots...
[unhinged chimpanzee hooting and chattering] Ooh ooh ooh! Ah ah ah! OOH OOH AH AH AAAAAH!
[long, shaky exhale] [sudden calm, tender, barely audible whisper] ...balls with dots.
